papers.title: Gaussian Process Random Fields
papers.abstract: Gaussian processes have been successful in both supervised and unsupervised machine learning tasks, but their computational complexity has constrained practical applications. We introduce a new approximation for large-scale Gaussian processes, the Gaussian Process Random Field (GPRF), in which local GPs are coupled via pairwise potentials. The GPRF likelihood is a simple, tractable, and parallelizeable approximation to the full GP marginal likelihood, enabling latent variable modeling and hyperparameter selection on large datasets. We demonstrate its effectiveness on synthetic spatial data as well as a real-world application to seismic event location.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了大规模高斯过程的近似方法，但与生物力学或植入物设计的替代建模无直接关联。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling, constraints, or UQ for implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on scalable GP approximation for spatial data.

summary_zh.motivation: 扩展高斯过程至大规模数据集
summary_zh.method: 通过局部GP耦合对近似进行并行化
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实空间数据上验证了可扩展性
summary_zh.validation: 合成数据与地震定位案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational bottleneck of Gaussian processes on large datasets.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian Process Random Field (GPRF) approximates the full GP via coupled local GPs with pairwise potentials.
summary_en.result: The GPRF achieves scalable inference and hyperparameter learning, demonstrated on synthetic spatial data and seismic event location.
summary_en.validation: Validation performed on synthetic benchmarks and a real-world seismic dataset.

papers.title: An integrated model for dendrite growth simulation in selective laser melting

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及选择性激光熔化中的枝晶生长模拟，与生物医学植入物方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: No biomedical context, no LPBF fabrication of porous implants, no mechanical testing or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 建立选择性激光熔化过程中枝晶生长的模拟模型
summary_zh.method: 采用集成模型模拟枝晶生长动力学
summary_zh.result: 实现了枝晶形态和尺寸的预测

summary_en.motivation: Develop an integrated model to simulate dendrite growth during selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: A combined thermal and phase-field model is used to predict dendritic solidification.
summary_en.result: The model captures dendrite morphology and growth kinetics.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical validation only, no experimental confirmation.
